observations: :repeat 5 sets the first Repeat: Edit 0/1080, selected duration 600 frames.
j, register a, dot sets the second Repeat: Edit 600/1200, both counts 5, register a retained.
qz, :repeat 6 records one setter: Edit 600/1320, selected duration 720 frames, register a retained.
q saves Macro z. One Undo restores Edit 600/1200 and count 5.
:macro z restores count 6 with one Undo. One Undo returns count 5 and keeps register a selected.
Cmd-Q exits cleanly. Closed headless reads retain two five-play root Repeats and Macro z with exactly one set_repeat_plays instruction for 6.
